report_metadata.sdlc_rationale: All four Predictive conditions satisfied: requirements fully defined and signed off by named stakeholders (VP HR, IT Director, Security), team has direct experience with stated stack (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Azure), no mid-project changes expected (must-have features locked, nice-to-have deferred), and deadline is fixed (June 30, 2026) with no flexibility mentioned.

project_understanding.primary_goal: Build a self-service employee onboarding portal enabling new hires to complete paperwork, IT account setup, and team introduction before day one.
project_understanding.beneficiary: New employees (100-200/year) and HR team (5 people)
project_understanding.trigger: Current onboarding is fragmented across PDFs and manual processes; CEO requested consolidation after hearing complaints at all-hands meeting.
success_definition: 80% of onboarding tasks completable by new hires before day one
IT account setup fully automated (zero manual tickets)
supporting_quotes: Currently onboarding is fragmented - paperwork is PDF-based, IT account setup is manual, new hires feel unprepared on day one.
CEO asked HR to fix this after hearing complaints at all-hands.
New hires can complete 80% of onboarding tasks before day one

assumption_log.what: Team composition (1 PM, 2 Developers, 1 UX Designer) is fully allocated at 100% to this project for the entire 4-month duration with no competing priorities.
assumption_log.why: Input specifies exact team size and roles but does not explicitly state full-time commitment or protection from multi-project allocation. For a Predictive project with fixed deadline and budget, full-time availability is the standard assumption; part-time or shared allocation would be flagged explicitly.
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 6th Ed, Section 9.2 — Resource allocation baseline requires confirmed availability before schedule baseline is set.
assumption_log.consequence: If any team member is part-time or shared with another project, critical path tasks slip and June 30 deadline becomes unachievable. Timeline would extend 6-8 weeks.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: allows schedule baseline to be calculated with integrity. Risks: if actual allocation is fractional, the plan is invalidated and must be re-baselined.

assumption_log.what: Workday API and Azure AD integration are available in sandbox/test environment with documented endpoints and authentication method confirmed before Phase 2 development begins.
assumption_log.why: Input names both integrations as required but does not state sandbox access is confirmed or API contracts are reviewed. For TYPE_A with external dependencies, sandbox access is a blocking prerequisite; assuming it exists avoids Phase 2 delays.
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 6th Ed, Section 11.2 — Risk identification requires external dependency validation before execution.
assumption_log.consequence: If sandbox access is not available or API documentation is incomplete, Phase 2 development blocks for 2-4 weeks waiting for vendor/IT approval. Critical path extends.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: allows Phase 2 to start on schedule. Risks: if access is delayed, entire backend development is blocked.

assumption_log.what: SOC 2 compliance scope is limited to data handling, audit logging, and access controls — not requiring a full SOC 2 audit certification before launch (audit occurs post-launch as part of ongoing compliance).
assumption_log.why: Input states 'SOC 2 compliance required' but does not specify whether a pre-launch audit certification is mandatory or whether compliance controls must be implemented and documented. For internal tools, SOC 2 controls are typically implemented and audited post-launch; pre-launch certification would add 4-6 weeks and is not standard for internal software.
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 6th Ed, Section 8.1 — Quality metrics defined before build; SOC 2 controls are quality requirements, not pre-launch audit gates.
assumption_log.consequence: If Security team requires pre-launch SOC 2 audit certification, Phase 4 extends 4-6 weeks and June 30 deadline is missed. Budget may increase $15-25K for audit services.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: allows Phase 4 to complete on schedule with documented controls. Risks: if pre-launch audit is required, timeline and budget both blow.

critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: PM, both Backend Developers, and UX Designer must be allocated full-time with zero context switching; any part-time allocation or shared project work will compress the critical path and force timeline slip.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: Requirements document finalized and signed by VP HR, IT Director, Security team
System architecture approved by IT Director
API contracts reviewed for Workday and Azure AD
Sandbox access confirmed for both integrations
UX wireframes approved by HR stakeholders
SOC 2 control requirements documented

tasks.name: Conduct stakeholder alignment session and document requirements
tasks.definition_of_done: Requirements document signed off by VP HR, IT Director, and Security team; no open questions on scope.

tasks.name: Design system architecture and data flow diagram
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture diagram reviewed and approved by IT Director; no unresolved technical questions.

tasks.name: Review Workday API and Azure AD integration contracts
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoints documented, authentication method confirmed, sandbox access request submitted and approved.

tasks.name: Create UX wireframes for onboarding flow
tasks.definition_of_done: Wireframes for all must-have features approved by HR stakeholders; accessibility requirements documented.

tasks.name: Document SOC 2 compliance requirements and control mapping
tasks.definition_of_done: Control matrix completed; Security team confirms scope does not require pre-launch audit certification.

phases.name: Core Development
milestones: Backend API endpoints for document collection implemented
Azure AD SSO integration working in sandbox
Workday employee data sync working in sandbox
Frontend task checklist and document upload UI complete
Internal demo with HR team completed; direction confirmed

tasks.name: Set up Node.js backend project, database schema, and API scaffolding
tasks.definition_of_done: PostgreSQL schema created, API routes scaffolded, local development environment working for both developers.

tasks.name: Implement document collection API endpoints (I-9, W-4, direct deposit)
tasks.definition_of_done: All three document endpoints accept file uploads, validate file types, store in secure location, return success/error responses.

tasks.name: Implement Azure AD SSO integration with token validation
tasks.definition_of_done: User can log in via Azure AD, token is validated, user identity is stored in session; sandbox testing complete.

tasks.name: Implement Workday API integration for employee data sync
tasks.definition_of_done: Employee data (name, department, manager, start date) syncs from Workday to local database; sandbox testing complete; error handling for API failures documented.

tasks.name: Build React frontend project and component library
tasks.definition_of_done: React + TypeScript project initialized, component library scaffolded, routing configured, local dev server running.

tasks.name: Implement task checklist UI and document upload form
tasks.definition_of_done: Task checklist displays all required tasks with due dates, document upload form accepts files, form validation works, UI matches approved wireframes.

tasks.name: Implement team introduction page with photos and roles
tasks.definition_of_done: Team member cards display name, photo, role, and department; data pulls from Workday sync; responsive design works on desktop and tablet.

tasks.name: Conduct internal demo with HR team and iterate on feedback
tasks.definition_of_done: Demo completed with HR team; feedback documented; direction confirmed; no scope changes requested.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases
milestones: E-signature integration (DocuSign or similar) working end-to-end
IT account provisioning workflow integrated with backend
All integrations tested in sandbox; ready for UAT
Security review completed; SOC 2 controls implemented
Error handling and edge cases tested

tasks.name: Integrate e-signature service (DocuSign API) for document signing
tasks.definition_of_done: User can sign documents via DocuSign embed, signed documents stored securely, audit trail captured; sandbox testing complete.

tasks.name: Implement IT account provisioning workflow (email, Slack, SaaS tools)
tasks.definition_of_done: Automated workflow creates email account, Slack user, and provisions SaaS tool access; no manual tickets required; error handling for provisioning failures documented.

tasks.name: Implement SOC 2 compliance controls (audit logging, access controls, encryption)
tasks.definition_of_done: All user actions logged with timestamp and user ID; sensitive data encrypted at rest and in transit; access controls enforced; audit log queries working.

tasks.name: Test error handling and edge cases (API failures, timeouts, invalid data)
tasks.definition_of_done: All error scenarios tested; graceful degradation confirmed; user-facing error messages clear; no unhandled exceptions.

tasks.name: Conduct security review and compliance sign-off
tasks.definition_of_done: Security team reviews code and controls; compliance sign-off obtained; no critical security findings; ready for UAT.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: All critical bugs resolved
UAT completed with HR team and new hire cohort
Accessibility audit completed (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Performance testing completed
Documentation and runbooks written
Adoption plan finalized

tasks.name: Execute comprehensive QA test plan (functional, integration, regression)
tasks.definition_of_done: All test cases executed; critical bugs logged and fixed; no open critical or high-severity bugs; test report signed off.

tasks.name: Conduct UAT with HR team and new hire cohort
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT completed with at least 5 new hires and 3 HR team members; feedback documented; all critical issues resolved; stakeholder sign-off obtained.

tasks.name: Perform accessibility audit and remediate issues (WCAG 2.1 AA)
tasks.definition_of_done: Accessibility audit completed; all WCAG 2.1 AA issues remediated; screen reader testing passed; keyboard navigation working.

tasks.name: Execute performance testing and optimization
tasks.definition_of_done: Page load time < 2 seconds; API response time < 500ms; concurrent user load test passed (100+ users); no performance regressions.

tasks.name: Write user documentation, admin runbooks, and troubleshooting guides
tasks.definition_of_done: User guide, admin guide, and troubleshooting guide completed; reviewed by HR team; all features documented; screenshots included.

tasks.name: Finalize adoption plan and communication strategy
tasks.definition_of_done: Adoption plan includes launch date, communication timeline, training sessions, and success metrics; approved by VP HR.

phases.name: Deployment & Handoff
milestones: Production deployment completed
Smoke testing in production passed
Go-live sign-off obtained
Post-launch monitoring and support plan activated

tasks.name: Deploy to production and execute smoke tests
tasks.definition_of_done: Application deployed to Azure App Service; all smoke tests passed; no errors in production logs; rollback plan tested.

tasks.name: Conduct go-live readiness review and obtain stakeholder sign-off
tasks.definition_of_done: Go-live checklist completed; VP HR, IT Director, and Security team sign off; launch date confirmed; support plan activated.

tasks.name: Establish post-launch monitoring, alerting, and support handoff
tasks.definition_of_done: Monitoring dashboards configured; alerting rules set for critical errors; on-call rotation established; HR team trained on basic troubleshooting.

risk_register.description: If Workday API sandbox access is not available or API documentation is incomplete, Phase 2 backend development will block for 2-4 weeks waiting for vendor approval, pushing critical path past June 30 deadline.
risk_register.trigger: Phase 2 begins and developer cannot authenticate to Workday sandbox or API endpoints are not documented
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm sandbox access and API contract review in Phase 1 (Task T3); establish vendor escalation contact before Phase 2 starts; request expedited access if needed.
risk_register.contingency: If access is delayed, pivot to mock Workday data for Phase 2 development; integrate real API in Phase 3 once access is available.

risk_register.description: If Azure AD SSO integration fails or token validation is incorrect, user authentication will not work, blocking all downstream features and UAT.
risk_register.trigger: Phase 2 Task T8 encounters authentication errors or token validation fails in sandbox testing
risk_register.mitigation: Allocate experienced backend developer to SSO integration; conduct early sandbox testing in Phase 1; document Azure AD configuration requirements upfront.
risk_register.contingency: If SSO integration fails, implement local authentication as fallback for UAT; migrate to SSO post-launch if needed.

risk_register.description: If Security team requires pre-launch SOC 2 audit certification (not just control implementation), Phase 4 will extend 4-6 weeks and June 30 deadline will be missed; budget may increase $15-25K.
risk_register.trigger: Security team requests formal SOC 2 audit certification before production launch
risk_register.mitigation: Clarify SOC 2 scope in Phase 1 Task T5; confirm with Security team that controls are implemented and documented but audit occurs post-launch; document this in writing.
risk_register.contingency: If pre-launch audit is required, defer non-critical features to Phase 2 post-launch; extend timeline to August 2026; request budget increase.

risk_register.description: If IT account provisioning workflow (email, Slack, SaaS tools) encounters API rate limiting or service unavailability, automated provisioning will fail and manual tickets will be required, defeating the primary success metric.
risk_register.trigger: Phase 3 Task T15 encounters rate limiting errors or provisioning service is unavailable during testing
risk_register.mitigation: Document rate limits and throttling constraints for all provisioning APIs in Phase 1; implement retry logic with exponential backoff; test under expected load.
risk_register.contingency: If provisioning fails, queue failed requests and retry asynchronously; alert IT team to manual provisioning; implement fallback notification workflow.

risk_register.description: If any team member (PM, Backend Developer, Frontend Developer, UX Designer) is pulled to another project or becomes unavailable, critical path tasks will slip and June 30 deadline will be missed.
risk_register.trigger: Team member is allocated to competing project or becomes unavailable (illness, departure) during Phases 2-4
risk_register.mitigation: Secure written commitment from department heads that team is protected from competing priorities; establish escalation path if conflicts arise; cross-train team members on critical tasks.
risk_register.contingency: If team member becomes unavailable, hire contractor to backfill role; extend timeline by 2-4 weeks; reduce scope to MVP.

risk_register.description: If stakeholders request scope additions (e.g., mobile app, LMS integration, chat bot) during development, Phase 2-3 timeline will extend and June 30 deadline will be missed.
risk_register.trigger: Stakeholder requests feature addition during Phase 2 or Phase 3 that is not in must-have list
risk_register.mitigation: Establish formal change control process in Phase 1; document nice-to-have features as Phase 2 post-launch; require VP HR approval for any scope changes.
risk_register.contingency: If scope change is requested, evaluate impact on timeline and budget; defer to Phase 2 post-launch if it impacts June 30 deadline.

risk_register.description: If e-signature integration (DocuSign) API is not available or has unexpected behavior, document signing workflow will not work, blocking UAT and launch.
risk_register.trigger: Phase 3 Task T14 encounters DocuSign API errors or integration behavior does not match documentation
risk_register.mitigation: Review DocuSign API documentation and sandbox environment in Phase 1; conduct early integration testing in Phase 2; use DocuSign test account.
risk_register.contingency: If DocuSign integration fails, implement alternative e-signature service (Adobe Sign, HelloSign); delay Phase 3 by 1 week.

risk_register.description: If Phase 1 requirements gathering is incomplete or stakeholders are unavailable for sign-off, Phase 2 development will start with ambiguous requirements, causing rework and timeline slip.
risk_register.trigger: Phase 1 Task T1 cannot be completed because stakeholders are unavailable or requirements remain ambiguous
risk_register.mitigation: Schedule Phase 1 kickoff immediately; block stakeholder calendars for Phase 1 meetings; prepare detailed requirements template before Phase 1 starts.
risk_register.contingency: If stakeholders are unavailable, proceed with PM and IT Director sign-off; obtain VP HR sign-off asynchronously; document assumptions.

risk_register.description: If performance testing reveals that the system cannot handle 100+ concurrent new hires during peak onboarding periods, infrastructure scaling will be required, extending Phase 4 and delaying launch.
risk_register.trigger: Phase 4 Task T22 performance testing shows response time > 2 seconds or system fails under 100+ concurrent users
risk_register.mitigation: Conduct load testing in Phase 3 with realistic data volumes; use Azure App Service auto-scaling; optimize database queries early.
risk_register.contingency: If performance issues are found, implement caching layer (Redis); optimize slow queries; increase App Service tier; delay launch by 1 week.

risk_register.description: If new hire satisfaction survey score target (> 4.0/5.0) is not met at launch, success metric is not achieved and post-launch improvements will be required.
risk_register.mitigation: Conduct UAT with representative new hire cohort in Phase 4; iterate on feedback; ensure onboarding flow matches user expectations; provide training to HR team.
risk_register.contingency: If satisfaction is low, conduct post-launch user research; prioritize improvements in Phase 2 post-launch; extend support period.

staffing_plan.notes: Full-time PM required for all phases; owns stakeholder alignment, requirements, and go-live sign-off. Critical path tasks: T1, T5, T18, T26.

Full-time backend developer required; owns API development, integrations, and infrastructure. Critical path tasks: T3, T8, T12, T15, T18, T25. Must have experience with OAuth and third-party API integration.
Full-time frontend developer required for Phases 2-4; owns UI implementation and accessibility. Critical path task: T12, T21. Must have strong accessibility experience.
Front-loaded UX designer for Phases 1-2; owns wireframes and design system. Can transition to part-time or other projects after Phase 2.
QA engineer required for Phases 3-4; owns test planning and execution. Allocation is 10% of total project hours (80h), which is 25% of development effort (320h), meeting PMBOK 8.2 minimum.

open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: If pre-launch audit certification is required, Phase 4 extends 4-6 weeks and June 30 deadline is missed; budget increases $15-25K.

open_questions.question: Is Workday API sandbox access already approved and available, or does it require a formal request that could delay Phase 2 development?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: If sandbox access is not available, Phase 2 backend development blocks for 2-4 weeks; critical path extends past June 30.

open_questions.question: Are the 4 team members (1 PM, 2 Developers, 1 UX Designer) fully allocated at 100% to this project with written protection from competing priorities, or is there risk of part-time allocation or multi-project pull?

pm_confidence_score.interpretation: PM confidence score is 82.0 because the project has a well-defined scope, fixed deadline, allocated budget, named stakeholders, and experienced team on a known technology stack (Predictive SDLC), but three external integration dependencies (Workday, Azure AD, e-signature) and SOC 2 compliance scope ambiguity introduce execution risk that cannot be fully mitigated until Phase 1 sign-off is complete.
